title: Form Energy about mosaic
description: A grey band with a four-photo mosaic on one side (two rows of a wide and a narrow tile, the second row mirrored, 10px gaps, 5px corners) and, centred against it, an orange-ruled condensed uppercase title, a light paragraph and an orange-outlined button. Phones stack the mosaic above the text.
notes: media takes up to four photos in reading order (wide, narrow, narrow, wide); empty tiles are placeholders
